steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each dispute is placed by its exposure figure and its next deadline.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Next deadline past
findings.fix: Act on the deadline or ask counsel for an extension

findings.title: Dispute with no exposure figure
findings.fix: Add the exposure with its source

findings.title: Exposure changed with no note of the reason
findings.fix: Note the reason for the change

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] dispute-0104.md:12  Next deadline past.
       Fix: Act on the deadline or ask counsel for an extension.
[medium] dispute-0102.md:19  Dispute with no exposure figure.
       Fix: Add the exposure with its source.
[low] dispute-0106.md:26  Exposure changed with no note of the reason.
       Fix: Note the reason for the change.
Not checked: The merits; the likely outcome.
pros: Checks a dispute with no exposure figure, a next deadline past, and an exposure figure that changed with no note of the reason.
cons: Not checked: The merits; the likely outcome.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-legal-disputes-log skill on the records for this review.
